  (hp : s.regs.get? Register.cur_privilege = some Privilege.Machine) (hc : s.regs.get? Register.mseccfg = some csr) :
  EStateM.run (interpretSailEffects (Functions.ext_decode 2130355)) s =

AnnealSail.MachineDecode.decode_execute_add_machine (a b csr : BitVec 64) (s : SequentialState RegisterType)
  (h1 : s.regs.get? Register.x1 = some a) (h2 : s.regs.get? Register.x2 = some b)
  (hp : s.regs.get? Register.cur_privilege = some Privilege.Machine) (hc : s.regs.get? Register.mseccfg = some csr) :
  EStateM.run
      (interpretSailEffects
        (have this := do
          let inst ← Functions.ext_decode 2130355
          Functions.execute inst;
        this))

    EStateM.Result.ok (ExecutionResult.Retire_Success ())
